system: Finnish Archipelago Bird Census / Common Eider (Somateria mollissima)

evidence_class.reason: the broad temporal response direction is already published and some island counts were reconstructed from grouped-island reports

public_metadata.survey_protocol: breeding numbers estimated by at least two annual counts under the Archipelago Bird Census guidelines for the core monitoring programme
public_metadata.grouped_island_redistribution: published methods state that summed pair numbers for groups of islands were redistributed to individual islands in some years; on average about 6.2% of observations per year and 7.4% of breeding females were affected
public_metadata.coordinate_privacy: published dataset metadata state that standardized latitude/longitude are rounded to one decimal
public_metadata.pos2_description: distance matrix based on coordinates in 2x2 km geographical grid cells

blocking_risks_before_any_source_loss_sc.surveyed_zero_semantics: must verify that an island-year row with Eider_pairs=0 is an explicit surveyed zero and that missing island-years are unsurveyed rather than zero
blocking_risks_before_any_source_loss_sc.spatial_geometry: rounded standardized Lat/Lon are not sufficient for a topology/source-leverage test unless exact keyed pos2 or another response-independent spatial object is present and usable
blocking_risks_before_any_source_loss_sc.reconstructed_counts: must determine whether redistributed grouped-island rows are identifiable; if not, source-loss events can be artifacts of imputation/reallocation
blocking_risks_before_any_source_loss_sc.annual_effort: must verify whether survey effort is comparable enough to distinguish true loss from varying survey coverage

stop_rules: STOP if zeros cannot be distinguished from unsurveyed island-years
STOP if no exact response-independent spatial object can be keyed to Island_ID
STOP if grouped-island reconstructed rows cannot be identified or prospectively excluded in a source-loss analysis
STOP if any retrospective source-loss contrast is selected using its observed effect direction

if_schema_audit_passes.next_step: freeze a retrospective three-wave event-construction rule using calendar windows and survey-support criteria before computing any source-loss leverage effect
if_schema_audit_passes.preferred_event: exactly one occupied-source loss between t0 and t1, followed by persistence/contraction of other occupied islands from t1 to t2
